title: Fix Aged Accounts Receivable (Report 120) performance on large ledger history
summary: Aged Accounts Receivable report (Report 120) now loads only necessary columns from Detailed Customer Ledger Entry records, significantly reducing query time on large ledger histories.
key_points: SetLoadFields applied to the Detailed Cust. Ledg. Entry loop to fetch only four required columns (Entry Type, Posting Date, Amount, Amount (LCY))
Change eliminates N+1 query pattern that scaled with full historical ledger size rather than open receivables
Update synchronized across W1, ES, and NA localization layers
